components.name: manual-sbom-audit
components.description: Manually curated. Known gaps: YAMCS transitive Java deps (Jetty, Jackson, Protobuf, Netty, Guava, RocksDB, SLF4J, Apache Commons); apt-installed system packages (libcurl4, libzmq3, gcc, cmake, binutils); Python transitive deps. Run: mvn dependency:tree -f yamcs/pom.xml and syft on container images for full coverage. No vulnerability scan data included — run grype or OWASP Dependency-Check.
